Definition: Use the same sample and calling period for all providers.
Define territory, industry and company fit before searching.
Use the same role criteria for each supplier.
Define the required role, company fit and contact route before scoring.
Give each supplier the same list. A 50-account pilot is directional, not conclusive.
Unique requested accounts with at least one contact matching the role criteria.
Keep missing coverage visible. Do not replace it with easier demo accounts.
Total rows exported before deduplication and quality checks.
Duplicates within this provider sample; do not delete different people sharing an HQ number.
Unique people with a number labelled mobile; the label is not proof of accuracy.
Unique people with a work direct line. Can overlap the mobile count.
Unique people linked to an HQ or switchboard number. Can overlap other types.
Unique people with none of the required phone fields available.
Count confirmed wrong numbers. Unanswered calls do not qualify.
Count shared numbers separately; coordinate calls at the account level.
Exclude do-not-call records and other applicable suppression records.
Unique people passing all agreed checks after deduplication and suppression.
Use the same currency across providers or document the conversion separately.
Include the appropriate subscription and seats share plus reveals, exports and enrichment. Exclude rep time and dialler costs.
Allocated sample data cost divided by usable unique contacts. If zero are usable, record no usable contacts.
Usable unique contacts divided by contacts exported. Do not use missing or blank values as zero.
Count people, not attempts. Do not call the same person twice to compare providers.
Mark shared records. Avoid assigning the same outcome to two providers.
Apply the same qualification definition and calling conditions.
Count meetings attended, separate from booked meetings and contact quality.
Record seats, credits, exports, renewal, cancellation and downloaded data rights.
Record what the sample supports and what remains unknown. No automatic winner.
